title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
slides: OpenAI just turned every image into a billboard?
Visual ads now appear beside DALL-E generations
But the ads don't match what you actually asked for
This means your brand could appear next to anything
Check today if your competitors are already buying these placements
thread_text:
1. Ads Next to DALL-E?

OpenAI just placed visual ads right beside every DALL-E generation. Your AI images now come with a side of sponsored content.

2. Ads Ignore Your Prompt

The ads are not for the thing you asked for. You prompt for a cat poster, you might see an ad for dog food.

3. Brands Land Anywhere

That mismatch means your brand could appear next to completely unrelated or even offensive AI art. No control, no context.

4. Competitors May Buy In

If your competitors are already buying these placements, they are showing up in every generation your team makes.

5. Audit Your Brand Today

Run five prompts on DALL-E right now. See if your logo or a rival's appears. If you haven't checked, do it today.
